symmetric_relic_check.interpretation: The tens-of-GeV hidden-SU(4) hadron branch cannot be a strong symmetric thermal relic under this geometric estimate.

claim_boundary: This is a branch-selection certificate: symmetric WIMP-like freeze-out is rejected for the tens-of-GeV hidden-SU(4) branch.
The exact ratio 82/15 is a substrate abundance ratio; a detector cross section is not derived here.
A heavier dark hadron remains possible if the dark asymmetry is correspondingly smaller than the baryon asymmetry.
